title: Independently bind G20 controller-query ranks and scratch episodes
body:
PR #5955 leaves the ranks of G20 WHOLE_IDLE and THIN controller queries as given inputs. This adds an independent checker that derives those ranks under the retained address model and binds them to both PR #5679/#5708 emitted streams. All 4,995 controller queries per candidate agree; no discrepancy was found.

It checks 3,330 idle jobs and every copy/query/delivery/owned-erasure episode for 1,665 thin jobs, including bank, port, stage identity and explicitly clean scratch. No predecessor implementation is imported. Local native queries and physical admission remain outside this check.

Two verified commits:

- `5f13cf6d7`: standalone rank/episode checker and self-contained controls, checked against both actual streams.
- `a06035c5f`: authenticated source inputs, registered replay, reproducible result and scoped proof.

Native Python 3.12 normal and optimized registered checks pass. Controls include 17 semantic mutations, altered ranks in both actual streams and changed source bytes. Committed-byte/source-history checks and official export/input coverage pass. Both modes pass in a fresh read-only Git-free export; all 17 exported files retain their bytes. Hosted CI is pending.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/g20-controller-query-ranks`.

The physical orthogonal-block/native interpretation, whole-job/erasure, compiler, precision/tape and supplier assumptions remain. This is neither a new multiplication bound nor BIT admission. Exact source pins and the next physical-review obligation are in the package.

Credit Matarener's #5955 question; Ali Romman, Dugongue, ai-nanachi and retained G20 authors; JoyboyBrian's related complex-supplier charging audit #5039. New checker by Dennis / antunishdPursuit with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0. [Claim and scope](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19273649). Complete remote overlap snapshots found no matching checker; sparse local coverage remains limited.
